meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档交给 NotebookLM，生成 kawaii 风格的幻灯片 PDF。生成约需 10 分钟，期间会先给你笔记本链接可实时查看；完成后给出 PDF 路径，配置了 WOWerpoint Server 时再返回手机端分享链接。
howto.when: 当你说「Wowerpoint <文件>」「把这份报告做成幻灯片」等说法，或要求把单个文档渲染成可分享的叙事幻灯片时触发。

say.note: 用默认 kawaii 提示词生成幻灯片

say.text: 把这份白皮书做成幻灯片
say.note: 标题取自文档 H1 或文件名

say.text: 用海盗主题做一份关于 notes.md 的幻灯片
say.note: 你给的提示词会原样传入

howto.what_en: Turns a single document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Generation takes ~10 minutes; you get a notebook link to watch live, then the PDF path, plus a mobile share link when WOWerpoint Server keys are set.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render one document as shareable narrative slides.

say_en.note: Runs the default kawaii prompt on that one document.

say_en.text: Turn this whitepaper into a slide deck
say_en.note: Deck title comes from the doc H1 or filename.

say_en.text: Make a deck about notes.md with a pirate theme
